newsitem.title: USA: P&G names U.S. Max Factor advertising firm.
newsitem.headline: P&G names U.S. Max Factor advertising firm.

text.p: Procter & Gamble Co said on Tuesday it will give its U.S. Max Factor cosmetics advertising business to the Leo Burnett advertising agency.
Burnett replaces Lotas Minard Patton McIver as Max Factor's agency of record in the United States.
The change to Burnett, which already handles all non-U.S. advertising for Max Factor, is effective immediately, the company said.

"This decision reflects our belief that, in the particular case of Max Factor, our future advertising can best be developed by a single, global agency," said Denis Beausejour, P&G's vice president of advertising.
Max Factor is growing strongly in Europe and Asia and the company has similar goals for the U.S., Beausejour said.
P&G sells the Max Factor brand in more than 50 countries.
